title: Adelic points and unmramified Brauer approximation for classifying stacks
summary: Let $k$ be a number field and let $G$ be a connected linear algebraic group over $k$. We compare three approaches to strong approximation for the classifying stack $BG$ with respect to its full Brauer group: the homogeneous-space method of \cite{DhillonClassifying}, Kottwitz's local--global sequence, and, for reductive groups, Borovoi's localization theorem. Under the natural identification \[ Br(BG)/Br(k)\simeq Pic(G), \] we identify the Kottwitz and Borovoi obstruction maps with Brauer evaluation.
